Bulletin No: 14 MWA/26/08/08/01
COLOR: Red
Warning for Strong Winds and Rough Seas
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 8.30 a.m. 08 August 2026
Valid for the period until 8.30 a.m. 09 August 2026.
For the sea areas extending from Chilaw to Mannar via Kalpitiya
and from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota
TAKE ACTION!
The sea areas off the coasts extending
from Chilaw to Mannar via Kalpitiya
and from Matara to Pottuvil via
Hambantota will be very rough at
times with strong gusty winds up to
(60-70) kmph. Naval and fishing
communities are advised not to
venture into these sea areas, until
further notice.
The sea areas off the coasts extending
from Batticaloa to Mannar via
Trincomalee and Kankasanthurai and
from Chilaw to Matara via Colombo and
Galle will be rough at times with strong
gusty winds up to (50-60) kmph. The
naval and fishing communities who are
engaged in fishing and naval activities
in the above sea areas are requested to
be vigilant in this regard.
Naval and fishing communities are
requested to be attentive to future
forecasts issued by the Department of Meteorology in this regard.
